intro_s1_left: Deep below his lab, the Professor gets hungry. "One pizza, please. Extra cheese!"
intro_s1_right: "Pizza on the Line! Coming right up!"
intro_s2: While he waits, he tinkers with his latest invention: the Time Shifter.
intro_s3_left: ZAP! A stray pulse fries his keycard.
intro_s3_right: Meanwhile, the pizza is on its way.
intro_s4_right: Ding-dong! The pizza is at the door, all the way up.
intro_s4_left: No keycard, no elevator. The only way up: straight through his own traps!
ending_e1: Made it! Hot pizza, right at the door.
ending_e2_left: Out of habit, he swipes the "fried" keycard...
